addon.name: Arctic Zephyr Stremio
addon.provider-name: shiggsy365 (based on Arctic: Zephyr - Reloaded by jurialmunkey, beatmasterRS)

extension.news: v1.2.7 - With several Kodi profiles: a profile picker beside the clock, and home widgets per profile. Context menus open without Kodi's showing first. The info page hides the last title's lists while it loads; hub rows refresh in place again. v1.2.6 - Information page: the episodes load once, on the next to watch; a previous title's seasons and episodes no longer show while the page loads. New splash. v1.2.5 - New Kodi Stremio Bridge splash on the startup screen, and in place of Kodi's own splash (Settings > Background). v1.2.4 - A show's seasons list previews each season's episodes without opening its information page. v1.2.3 - The info page's plot always starts from the top (it could open already scrolled). v1.2.2 - Hubs load only the list you pick: the row shows the first catalog, and changes when you click another chip (moving across the chips no longer loads each one). v1.2.1 - Installs YouTube (trailers) and Up Next (next episode) with the skin.
extension.summary: Arctic: Zephyr - Reloaded, made for Stremio Bridge.
extension.description: A fork of Arctic: Zephyr - Reloaded by beatmasterRS, itself based on Arctic: Zephyr by jurialmunkey, made to work with Stremio Bridge and Dispatcharr Bridge. Clean, minimal and light, with the layout of Reloaded. Licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 3.0, like the original.
